name: Pixley AI
long_description:
Pixley turns kids' drawings and ideas into fully animated cartoons – in minutes.

Kids are natural storytellers. With Pixley, any kid can draw a character, describe a world, and watch their story come to life as a personalized animated cartoon.

Most kids' screen time is broken: passive, algorithmic content designed to keep kids watching, not growing. Pixley is the antidote. Every episode is safe, ad-free, and built around Social-Emotional Learning (SEL). Parents can choose any lesson they want to teach their child, and Pixley weaves it naturally into the story their kids create. We're building the creative platform for the next generation – where kids are the directors, not just the audience.

Additionally, the same technology powers Pixley Studios, our B2B content service for brands and content creators who want to produce high-quality AI video without the cost or time of traditional production.

We’re 19 year old CS dropouts who’ve known each other since elementary school and won 4 hackathons at 15. After seeing AI flood the internet with low-quality content, we created Pixley – a safe, personalized way for kids to turn their ideas into animated stories.
one_liner: The first platform where families can create AI cartoons in minutes

launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋\
\
We’re [Pranit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranit-agrawal/) and [Krish](https://www.linkedin.com/in/krish-iyengar/) – the co-founders of [Pixley AI](https://pixleyai.com/).

**Pixley turns kids’ drawings and ideas into personalized, high-quality animated episodes – guided by parents’ educational and behavioral goals.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94447&key=user_uploads/2396632/e8c1fb0c-2d87-4bce-877f-524eb4dd3b71)

# **TL;DR**

* **🎨 From doodles to characters instantly**: Draw on your screen or upload a picture and watch it come to life in seconds
* **🧑‍🏫 Parent-guided learning:** Parents can simply describe any lesson they’d like to teach their child, and we’ll create an entire cartoon episode for it
* **📞 Character calling:** Kids can hop “on the phone” with their new friends, and talk endlessly about any educational topic
* **📚 Educational, Active Learning:** Make screen time engaging and safe while encouraging creativity

**_Ask:_**

👉 _Use our [website](https://pixleyai.com/) and [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pixley-personalized-cartoons/id6751121342) to create any cartoon you want!_

👉 _Share this post! We all know parents and teachers that could benefit from Pixley_

👉 _Send any feedback over to [admin@pixleyai.com](mailto:admin@pixleyai.com)_

### https://youtu.be/h9sc9PgjfC0

### **❌ The Problem**

**Endless Scrolling**

Kids aged 2-8 spend an average of **2 hours and 48 minutes every day** on screens. Nearly all of it is passive consumption of algorithm-driven videos, with little opportunity for creativity or active learning.\
\
**Guilt Without Good Options**

Parents prefer screen time that is both fun and educational. Right now, they have to choose between entertaining caartoons designed for engagement, or educational apps that feel like homework.

**Behavioral Learning is Overlooked**

Studies show Social and Emotional Learning (SEL) programs boost achievement by **11 percentile points**. Yet schools rarely emphasize it. That leaves kids missing critical skills – like handling frustration, working with others, and bouncing back from setbacks – lessons every parent wants taught early.

### ✅ Our Solution

At Pixley, we are using the newest video generation technologies to allow families to make AI cartoon shows within minutes.

⏳ **Instant Character Creation**

Children can draw directly on the screen or upload any picture – even a photo of themselves, their family, or friends. Pixley transforms it into a fully animated character in seconds, which can be saved into the character library and used in future episodes. For the first time, your child can actually **star in their own cartoons.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94447&key=user_uploads/2396632/6251e031-0c2d-49e0-83a4-2daeae7c20d2)

📺 **Personalized Cartoon Episodes**

Parents simply describe what they want the episode to be about – from sharing with siblings, to learning fractions, or exploring space. Pixley generates an entire animated episode around that theme, starring the child’s characters, within minutes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94447&key=user_uploads/2396632/706b3cee-18f4-45ea-b687-e68db2f73a79)

**📞 Character Calling**

Kids can “call” their characters and hold conversations on any topic, like FaceTiming a cartoon friend that never runs out of things to say. Our characters will personalize to your child and teach them about their favorite topics!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94447&key=user_uploads/2396632/46e126b1-ce44-4119-a242-0260b7f84921)

**🌎 The Storyverse**

Don’t have time to make an episode? No worries, our Storyverse has a growing library of Pixley Original educational cartoons that are ready to watch!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94447&key=user_uploads/2396632/150a8e8a-08cf-4dbe-8a7d-3c45513459a4)
